_comment: NON-RUNNABLE INSTALLATION TEMPLATE for Codex CLI hooks. Codex loads hooks from a hooks.json or inline hook tables in its user configuration. Requires codex_hooks enabled. Replace both placeholders with verified absolute paths before installing; unrendered placeholders must never be deployed.
_paths_note: Replace @HESTIA_HOME@, @HESTIA_WORKSPACE@ and @HESTIA_PLUGIN_ROOT@ at install time (deploy/register-members.py does: @HESTIA_HOME@ is the deploying environment's HESTIA_HOME as an absolute path, refused when unset -- the gate and the witness load the seat projection through it, #1242). HESTIA_ROLE is passed through with install.default_role as its default (codex declares none: the token is dropped and the daemon default applies). @HESTIA_PLUGIN_SOURCE@ is the deployed plugin directory: hydrate.sh reads instance/identity.seed.json from CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT, and the installer does not copy the seed under the dest. The deployer owns the lines it installs and rewrites them to this template on each deploy (dp 2026-10-06). The public repository carries no operator-specific workspace path.
_timeout_contract: One-gate stage C. The PreToolUse gate READS its timeout from the registration this template becomes (seconds; an entry without one is refused, since Codex's default is not documented here) and decides inside start + timeout - 1.5 s, so it always fails closed before Codex kills it (Codex marks a timed-out hook failed and the tool call continues, i.e. fail-open). 15 s absorbs a cold member connect (measured 4.6-5.1 s). A shorter registration costs availability, never safety; deploy/register-members.py reports one below this floor.
_witness_note: witness.py is the hook that reaches the daemon (hestia_begin_action + hestia_record_outcome); observe.sh only appends the raw event to a local file. Before #1133 only observe.sh was registered here, so no codex act ever reached the chain while the inventory read the member as governed.
